questions.question: Hypokalaemia is caused by the deficiency of ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. Potassium.

__
 
• **Potassium**__ is the most common electrolyte for the human body.
 
• Hypokalaemia is a disease caused by a lower level of potassium.
 
• Potassium is very important electrolytes required in the formation of Adenosine triphosphate(ATP) and Na-K ATPase pump.

questions.question: Which of the following texts gives a detailed account of the kings of Kashmir?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1, i.e. Rajatarangini.

__
 
• **Rajatarangini**__** **literally translates to ‘The River of Kings’.
 
• This work in Sanskrit was authored by Historian Kalhana in the 12th century.
 
• It is divided into eight books each of which is called ‘Tarang’.
 
• Rajatarangini tells the history of Kashmir.

questions.question: In the context of the Internet, what is the full form of MAN?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. Metropolitan Area Network.

__
 
• **MAN is Metropolitan Area Network**__** **and is used to connect two or more LANs in a common geographic area: say a city or a group of buildings. 
 
• MANs can span in the range of 5 to 50 kilometers in diameter. 
 
• MANs usually are not owned by a single organization, they are owned by an association of users or by a single network provider who sells the service to the users.
 
• It interconnects users with computer resources in a geographic area or region larger than that covered by even a large local area network (LAN) but smaller than the area covered by a wide area network (WAN).

questions.question: In the context of the banking system in India, what does IFSC stand for?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4,i.e. Indian Financial System Code.

__
 
• IFSC stands for **Indian Financial System Code**__.
 
• It is represented by the 11 digits alpha-numeric character.
 
• We can usually see it on your bank’s cheque leaves, or other bank sponsored material.
 
• This code helps identify the individual bank branches that participate in the various online money transfer options like NEFT and RTGS.

questions.question: Which country has become the second country in the world to declare a climate and biodiversity emergency?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3,i.e. Ireland.

__
 
• **Ireland**__ has become the second country in the world to declare a climate and biodiversity emergency.
 
• It happened after the Oireachtas (Irish parliament) report on Climate Action was accepted by the government and opposition parties without a vote.
 
• Ireland followed in the footsteps of the United Kingdom, which declared a climate emergency earlier this month after 16-year-old Swedish climate activist Greta Thunberg addressed MPs urging more climate action and in the wake of protests by climate action group Extinction Rebellion.

questions.question: Which of the following is a western flowing river?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. Sabarmati.

__
 
• **Sabarmati River**__ is the west-flowing river. 
 
• It originates from the Dhebar Lake in Aravalli range at Udaipur, Rajasthan.
 
• It finally merges with the Arabian Sea at the Gulf of Cambay/Khambhat after covering a distance of 371 km.
 
• Gomti, Krishna and Mahanadi all are east-flowing rivers.

questions.question: In May 2019, the kilogram was redefined for the first time in 130 years. It will now be redefined by a fundamental property of nature known as:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. Planck's Constant.

__
 
• India has adopted a global resolution to redefine four of the seven base units - kilogramme, kelvin, mole and ampere.
 
• A resolution to redefine four of the seven base units was passed by representatives of 60 countries at the General Conference on Weights and Measures (CGPM) of the International Bureau of Weights and Measures (BIPM), Paris on November 16 last year.
 
• The kilogram has been defined since 1889 by a shiny piece of platinum-iridium held in Paris. All modern mass measurements are traceable back to it - from micrograms of pharmaceutical medicines to kilos of apples and pears and tonnes of steel or cement.
 
• The new SI System will be helpful in bringing in accuracy while dealing with international trade, biotechnology, high-tech manufacturing and human health and safety.
 
• **The new definition of kg involves accurate weighing machines called 'Kibble balance', which uses Planck's Constant__ to measure the mass of an object using a precisely measured electromagnetic force.**

questions.question: Which one of the following is NOT a tributary of river Kaveri?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4, i.e. Vaigai.

__
 
• **Vaigai is a river in Tamil Nadu state**__, southern India, it flowing 240 km generally southeast.
 
• It originated in the Varushanad Hills of western Tamil Nadu, it initially flows northeast through the Kambam and Varushanad valleys.
 
• After the central reaches, the Vaigai flows eastward into the Vaigai reservoir at Narasingapuram.
 
• Near Sholavandan it bends to the southeast, passing Madurai on its course to its mouth on Palk Strait, which separates the southeastern coast of India from Sri Lanka.
 
• The Vaigai River rarely floods; its chief tributaries are the Siruliar, Theniar, Varaha Nadi, and Mangalar.
 
• Amaravati, Bhavani and Kabini are the tributaries of river Kaveri.

questions.question: According to which Article enshrined in the Constitution of India shall the council of ministers be collectively responsible to the Lok Sabha?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. Article 75.

__
 
• According to **Article 75**__ of Indian Constitution, the ministers are collectively responsible to the Parliament in general and to the Lok Sabha in particular. 
 
• Lok Sabha is the bridge between the Executive (Laws implemented by the Executive) and the Legislature (Laws framed) after deliberations on the laws in force and making the necessary amendments based on the current social, political and economic fabric of our country.
 
• The Lok Sabha is the lower house of our bicameral Parliament.
 
• The total number of Council of Ministers, which includes the Prime Minister, shall not exceed fifteen per cent of the total number of members of Lok Sabha.

questions.question: In the cabinet of the 17th Lok Sabha, who has been appointed as the Finance Minister?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1, i.e. Nirmala Sitaraman.

__
 
• **Nirmala Sitharaman**__ is the recent Finance minister in the present Lok Sabha.
 
• She forayed into politics in 2008 as a member of BJP and spent the remnants of her time as a spokesperson of the party until she was inducted into Narendra Modi's cabinet in 2014.
 
• She was elected to Rajya Sabha in 2014 and subsequently in 2016.
 
• She served as the Minister of Defense, the second woman to hold the post since Indira Gandhi.
